story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Founded in Riyadh in 2021, Pioneer started as a small online electronics store with a simple goal: to make the latest technology easy to buy for everyone in Saudi Arabia. Since then, we've become a trusted destination for more than 25,000 customers.
story.paragraph2: Today we offer more than 3,000 products — phones, laptops, gaming PCs, monitors, smartwatches, audio, accessories and eyewear — and deliver to more than 40 cities across the Kingdom. Quality, customer service and competitive prices remain at the heart of everything we do.
story.paragraph3: We believe technology should make your life easier, not more complicated. That's why we go beyond selling products: we offer expert advice, dependable support and a shopping experience that puts you first.
